additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists medicationrequest and MedicationRequest.informationSource as active current-build entries. Later FHIR-49863 work renamed MedicationRequest.reported to MedicationRequest.isRecordOfRequest and commit 7ede8c1b57bc3c9238e2c3c8d530b7697ad3a39d updated the FHIR-47855 wording accordingly. A checked-in medicationrequest.svg tooltip still contains the old sentence, but that is a generated-looking diagram artifact and the authoritative XML is correct.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current combined-branch StructureDefinition already has the clarified definition/comment and no additional core source edit is needed for this issue.
